thread:
julia-partnerships: quick sync — MTN partner wants to onboard a Ghana region (wafrica-1) into cloud marketplaces (aws + gcp). they need quota allocations, KMS entitlements, and a coordinated announcement window. who owns the quota requests? :eyes:
raj-ops: i can own quotas and infra capacity. need exact SKU list + expected qps/peak gpus. jl, can you share partner expected patterns?
mike-capacity: FYI our current dedicated pools in af-south are ~70% used during peak. wafrica-1 will likely need new edge nodes or burst routing -> estimate 4x A10G for initial launch. pinged hw partner (nvidia-intl) for availability.
julia-partnerships: partner expects 50 rps steady for chat + spikes to 250 rps during promos. approximate per-request tokens ~150. they're ok starting with 4 GPUs and scaling to 12 within 3 months.
claire-sales: marketing wants a soft joint announcement on D+21, legal ok with embargo if we get entitlements by D+7. need marketplace listing approved earlier.
ling-legal: KMS + data residency notes — partner requires customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-kms). we'll need to route the private deployment option and a SOC2 attestation in the listing. timeline?
raj-ops: for KMS we'll need an integration ticket with infra-sec. tagging @cloudpartner-bot to create a KMS onboarding task. also need subnet/peering plan for wafrica-1 VPC.
cloudpartner-bot: Created ticket INFRA-8742: "wafrica-1 KMS onboarding + peering" — assignee: raj-ops, due: 5 business days.
mike-capacity: quota request draft (to send to AWS partner ops):
```
{
  "region": "wafrica-1",
  "sku_requests": ["rtx-a10g:4","rtx-a10g:8:reserve"],
  "expected_peak_rps": 250,
  "fallback_region": "af-south-1"
}
```
julia-partnerships: i'll coordinate the partner to confirm the SKU strings. also want the marketplace listing copy reviewed — sales + legal please. Claire, can you own marketing assets?
claire-sales: yep. i'll draft the joint blog + a partner quote. need logo and 2-line partner description from them. timeline: draft by EOD Tue.
ling-legal: i'll review copy once provided. also flag: we need a clause about capacity fallbacks and outage SLAs — partner expects a 99.9% SLA in contract. advise sales.
claire-sales: noted. i'll align with partner on a fallback runbook and mention limited SLA during initial window.
raj-ops: technical blockers: (1) GCP marketplace test images need vendor onboarding — that's separate ticket. (2) KMS BYOK requires HSM approval if they want HSM-backed keys. mike, any issues with burst routing across af-south?
mike-capacity: burst is fine but adds egress costs. if we should keep traffic local, we need 2 edge nodes in Ghana colocations — that's procurement lead time ~6 weeks. recommend start with routing to af-south and enable cache priming + KV prefix caching to reduce token use.
julia-partnerships: decision: start with af-south fallback routing + reserved 4 GPUs in wafrica-1 (soft reserve) and no HSM for initial launch. partner ok with that.
raj-ops: i'll submit quota requests today. sending the AWS marketplace entitlement doc to partner for signatures.
cloudpartner-bot: Reminder: marketplace checklist updated: entitlements, KMS, images, SOC2 link, billing mapping. checklist progress: 1/7.
julia-partnerships: final asks for this thread: (1) raj, share quota request ticket link once submitted; (2) mike, confirm burst plan & expected egress estimate; (3) claire, draft marketing timeline; (4) ling, preliminary legal checklist. i'll consolidate and schedule a 15m sync tomorrow. thanks :rocket:
raj-ops: will share INFRA-8743 (quota request) shortly.
mike-capacity: egress estimate ~ $800/month initial with af-south fallback, ~ $2400/month if we colocate in gh. will add to ticket.
claire-sales: draft timeline in Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link (draft)
ling-legal: compiling checklist, will post in #legal-reviews channel and add to the marketplace ticket.
julia-partnerships: great — tagging @here for visibility. i'll create the sync invite for 09:00 UTC tomorrow. :calendar:
